title: I expected Melt in my mouth roast, not so.
text:
I expected Melt in my mouth roast, not so.. This is my first time with a Chard Vacuum Tumble Marinator, or any type of Marinator etc.
For the first time using this, I bought a chuck roast that is a less expensive cut of meat, needs marinating, tenderizing etc. to find out if this really works.
Thought I would get a melt in your mouth roasts after using this. Not so sure about that!

it comes with EASY Simple directions, Pictures, And a Phone number .
But the Red Function light never came on for me!!
Although I did not think that make a difference in the way this worked.

This is a large, 1 1/2 Gal. Tumbler, which holds allot. The chuck roast I put in was only 2 1/2 lbs and it looked small in this.
Comes with only 3 recipes ! (I expected more.)
1. Grilled shrimp and scallops kabobs.
2. Teriyaki chicken wing’s.
3. Lemon pepper pork chop marinade.

The tube is connect in a little compartment under where the tumbler sits to suck the Air out.
Connect the tube to the tumbler, Turn the knob to Vacuum. It automatically will show the time, and will shut off when the time counts down.
Before sucking the air out and tumbling, I put allot of seasoning on my Chuck roast, even used the tenderize thingie I have by hand to put holes in the meat..
Then Putting it into the Tumbler to suck the air to infuse the spices.
Also the meat expands to let the seasoning all in.
After I put it on the Tumbler mode, as I believe this tenderizes the meat.
I was making a chuck roast for the crockpot..
When the tumbling stopped, I then put the roast into a hot Pan to Sear it, with Olive oil, Red Wine, & sliced thick mushrooms.
Added more garlic.

Before putting the roast into the newer slow cooker, I put in a large trader joe container of beef broth, potatoes, carrots, celery, & onions, along with the
drippings, more seasonings, and everything that was inside the Sear pan. Along with my chuck roast into the slow cooker for 8 hours.

After 8 hours, we ate it for dinner. We where expecting this roast to melt in our mouth!! Both my Husband and I didn't think this lived up to its potential,
Of a melt in your mouth roast, with tons of seasoning, and it was even kind of dry tasting, not as tender as expected, although covered with liquid etc while cooking.!!

Just want to mention, I have made this type of roast before, but Not often, although putting it inside the oven instead of the crock pot, and not using this
tumbler, it has been before , a melt in your mouth awesome roast.

When people say they used this for chicken, and it was so tender. I have Never make a Chicken or any chicken parts that where Not Tender.
I usually only make chicken breasts, which is white meat and is dryer then other parts that are dark meat. Never have I made dry chick breasts.

This is my 3rd day of this left over cooked roast sitting in my Frig. And today it finally tastes tender, & juicy.
I never had to let a chuck roast marinate after cooking for 3 days for it to taste like it now does.
This is my reason for giving this 3 stars..(maybe should have been 2 stars !)

I’ll give the Chard Vacuum Tumble Marinator, another chance using a Brisket (another type of meat that needs tenderizing).
That said, before when I make a Brisket, slow cooking, I let it sit in my frig for 3 days before eating it.
But not a pot roast.

If it comes out more tasty, more tender, right after its cooked, I will be back with a update.

description: The CAREY Vacuum Tumble Marinator is perfect for marinating meat, chicken, fish and vegetables like the professionals do. This vacuum tumbler has an easy-to-use digital control panel and timer that ensures optimal results for your food every time. The built-in vacuum pump pulls the marinades into your meat adding maximum taste and texture and the tumbling action infuses and tenderizes, making your food ready for the grill in minutes rather than hours. This unit can marinate up to 6 lbs. of meat at a time, in as little as 15 minutes. The large capacity 160 oz. marinade container is dishwasher safe and BPA free. Easy-to-follow steps and mouthwatering recipes are included. Create restaurant quality meals in minutes!
